issues.description: Builder r2 re-ran the critic harness and rewrote parser/tests/results/gate-r1.json (tests/ is critic-owned). Mitigated: pre-fix critic copy preserved at gate-r1-critic-pre-r2.json and this critic independently re-ran everything (gate-r2.json). Process note only.

Landed flight_log_summary has no columns (nor jsonb overflow) for armed_duration_s, start_time_utc, vehicle, max_alt_source, message_counts - silently dropped on DB write. start_time_utc is needed by bulk-dump intake (flight stubs from log timestamps). Needs one schema-phase ALTER; db.py introspects and will pick them up automatically.
Health-score thresholds partly ASSUMPTION (motor spread 15%, RSSI dropout rule, deduction weights) and wind estimate not computed (wind column NULL). Labelled in-file; unchanged since r1.

Offline cells inference ambiguous (corpus inferred 12/13/14/15 across 101 Quiver logs vs seeded Quiver cells=14). All per-cell values still land in the 2.5-4.6 V plausibility band; live watcher path uses aircraft_types.cells via join, so this only affects CLI use without --cells.
